windows.title: Queue watch
windows.note: All 10 documented US queue openings in 2026 fell between 10:09 AM and 1:13 PM ET, and 5 of the 10 were on a Wednesday.
windows.action: Stay logged in with your card and address saved. If the queue appears, stay in it and don't reload.

windows.title: Online and in-club drop watch
windows.note: Sources conflict. Weekday mornings, most often Tuesday, are the common report, and one tracker says 11 PM ET online. Limit is usually 2 per membership.
windows.action: Check the app before you drive. Keep hot items bookmarked for a week because canceled orders get re-dropped.

windows.title: Drawing entry window
windows.note: Ran at this time on Oct 14, 21, 28, and Nov 4. Each drawing sets its own window, and the item list usually appears 1 to 2 days ahead.
windows.action: Check the price against the Flip List first. If you're picked, Walmart charges you automatically.

windows.title: Online queue
windows.note: Lower priority now. Most Pokémon has moved to drawings since late August, and the queue has mostly carried other card brands.
windows.action: Load the product page before 9 PM to join the waiting room. A spot in the queue or in your cart doesn't reserve stock.

windows.title: In-store vendor check
windows.note: Low confidence. One guide says weekday mornings with Thursday most common. Another says any time Thursday through Saturday, with vendors told to vary their route.
windows.action: Ask a toy-department employee which day your store's card vendor comes.

windows.title: Overnight online wave
windows.note: Trackers place 81 to 86% of Target's online restocks between 3 and 6 AM ET, with Friday the biggest day.
windows.action: Before bed, save your payment and address and bookmark the product page. Set an alarm if the item is worth it.
